== Summary ==

The matching after crop is [[:File:V24-L-cloudcitylowercorridor-2024-12-29-change-crop-after.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Cloud City: Lower Corridor (V) (Playtest)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/cloudcitylowercorridor.gif commit 3d2c89e]) and [[Cloud City: Lower Corridor (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Light/large/cloudcitylowercorridor.gif commit efc26cd]).
